reviewedFrozenLineage.sourcePolicy: raw r4 full-dressed source only; no r4/r5 target, mask, layer, or composite input

visualReview.method: nearest-neighbour review of the frozen 160x160 target and isolated layer, compared against the r6 raw full-dressed source, art-inbox helmet reference, and original base crop
visualReview.helmetCups: PASS: both screen-left and screen-right helmet ear cups/fins retain rounded, continuous blue-and-gold contours. No flat dark-blue rectangle or rectilinear crop protrusion remains; r4's x31..37/y28..40 defect is absent.
visualReview.naturalEars: PASS: no pink natural-ear tip remains; both ears are replaced by the integrated helmet fins.
visualReview.tail: PASS: the screen-right tail remains visibly original and is not consumed by the headwear layer.
visualReview.collar: PASS: the lower helmet rim follows a smooth curved neck/cheek boundary without a square block, vertical cut seam, or halo.
visualReview.overall: PASS: the extracted same-coordinate layer reads as a redrawn, worn closed helmet rather than a pasted accessory, and matches the intended full-dressed visual at release-review scale.

scopeLimit: This approves only c01/front as an r6 verified source-layer package. It does not approve remaining 19 head-20 cells, other wearables, a runtime manifest change, or a release/push.
